verdict.rationale: Datalab offers some version stability: callers can pin agent processors as <id>@<version> (datalab-docs-40), pipelines are saved as versioned configurations (datalab-docs-38), and a public changelog records changes such as the Forge rename (datalab-docs-45). There is no evidence of versioning the API surface itself, and no OpenAPI spec was found (datalab-probe-2). missing for 10: versioned API endpoints (e.g. /v1), a documented deprecation policy or sunset timelines, breaking-change notification commitments, a published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.
